Content: Systems `A` and `B` contain identical ideal springs and identical blocks that can slide along a surface of negligible friction. In system `A`, the surface is horizontal. In system `B`, the surface makes an angle `theta` with the horizontal. Initially, both blocks are at rest and in equilibrium. `text(Each block)` is then pulled the same distance `d` in the direction shown in the figures and released from rest at `t=0`.
